items.title: Show HN: Rollcall – Simulated Film Development on iPhone with Shared Rolls
items.contentSnippet:
Hey Show HN!
I've been working on an idea called Rollcall, which simulates physical and film cameras and the film development process in real time rather than apply a post-processing filter or LUT to photos.
You can generate any kind of camera you can think of, real, imagined, something you've used or something you always wanted to try.
Shared social rolls also let friends share a film roll for an event, party, trip, whatever - and the photos only develop once the full roll has been shot.

items.title: Show HN: Ember – Redshift safe color palettes
items.contentSnippet:
Most color palettes collapse if you've got a strong redshift/nightshift color filter actively suppressing green and blue channels. I made one that doesn't.
Ember has terminal, chart, heatmap, and UI palettes designed and tested to be as distinguishable as possible under both the redshift & non-redshift condition... so no more duplicate color appearances (or worse yet, disappearing colors!).

items.title: Show HN: TokenSpend, the AI ROI Solution
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN, I was curious about how most companies and individuals were using AI without any meaningful insights. I built TokenSpend (https://tokenspend.dev/); we find existing ROI on AI code usage by tracking how much output was produced for your agent sessions, identifying inefficiencies with AI usage, and then, based on that data, we route you through the most efficient model. Solo devs can also use it as an AI Gateway with visibility into their spend.

items.title: Show HN: A tool to auto-generate .vscode/settings.json and extensions.json
items.contentSnippet:
Hello HN,
I built a tool that automatically generates .vscode's settings.json and extensions.json.
## Why I built this
At my job, our project didn't have a properly set up dev environment, and each developer managed their own .vscode settings individually. I felt this was hurting PR review efficiency due to formatting differences and similar issues.
